summary_1line: Shurpanakha, mutilated and terrified, tells Khara that Rama slew the demons sent after him and urges her brother to confront Rama.

image_candidates.scene_text: Shurpanakha, her nose and ears severed and blood flowing, writhes on the ground before Khara in the demon forest.
Shurpanakha tearfully recounts how Rama’s arrows felled fourteen armed demons in an instant.
The terrified Rakshasi stretches her hands toward Khara, begging him to avenge the fallen demons and face Rama.
